amendment.change: Primary claim restricted to lr_effect_freq (effect + freq_shrunk). lr_effect_freq_depmap remains reported as a secondary, caveated number.
amendment.clean_model_definition: lr_effect_freq reads only screen A own SCORE.1 and a frequent-hitter prior fitted on dataset.allowed_background_screens(unit), which excludes both pair screens, both publications and every screen in the pair cell line, inside the ORCS safe boundary. It reads no DepMap product.
amendment.reason: The selection rule picked lr_effect_freq_depmap on out-of-fold score. On provenance grounds that model cannot carry the headline: DepMap CRISPRGeneEffect IS the Broad Avana experiment, and Meyers 2017 (PMID 29083409) is the Avana publication, which is the label side for 113 of the 124 held-out pairs. depmap_features drops the unit own DepMap model, so there is no per-cell-line leak, but a breadth summary over ~1,177 other Avana lines is the same experiment aggregated, and docs/07 already records that such an aggregate cannot be assumed temporally or target independent.

heldout_stratification_declared_in_advan.hub: pairs whose two publications are Behan 2019 and Meyers 2017
heldout_stratification_declared_in_advan.reason: docs/07-replication-benchmark.md records that 113 of 124 held-out pairs are that one comparison, so the effective n for cross-library generalisation is near 1 and a result must be reported both ways

paired_test: percentile bootstrap resampled by screen pair, plus Wilcoxon; a difference whose CI crosses zero is not an improvement
purpose: select one replication-reliability model using development data only
selection_rule: highest leave-one-publication-out mean average precision among the fitted combinations in simple.COMBOS; single features ineligible
